name: WYBOT
headline: WYBOT ownership, Tianjin manufacturing, products and regional channels
description: A source-backed profile separating the WYBOT brand from WYBOTICS, with controlling-shareholder evidence, own-brand and ODM manufacturing, regional entities and model-level buyer checks.
metaDescription: WYBOT company profile: WYBOTICS ownership, Tianjin manufacturing, pool robots, solar skimmers, ODM business, channels and strategy.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with WYBOT or WYBOTICS. The April 2026 Hong Kong document was a draft application proof, and recall or factory evidence is applied only within its stated model, date and market scope.

ownership.summary: WYBOT is a company-owned robotic pool-cleaner brand of WYBOTICS Co.,LTD, the Tianjin business formerly known as Tianjin Wangyuan Environmental Protection & Technology Co., Ltd. The April 2026 Hong Kong application proof said Fu Guilan, Yu Qian and controlled entities together held 71.58% of voting control as of 15 April 2026. That figure covers a defined controlling-shareholder group and does not mean the company was wholly family-owned. The filing was a draft application proof, not evidence of a completed listing.

productPortfolio.name: C- and B-series cordless pool cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: Cordless residential robots spanning above-ground, mainstream in-ground, wall-climbing and AI-vision configurations.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Supports price and feature tiering, but exact pool coverage, wall behavior, filters and battery specifications vary by model.

productPortfolio.name: S-series intelligent pool cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: Higher-tier robots with navigation, mapping, docking and solar-assisted options.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Adds premium system requirements around docks, installation, app connectivity and market-specific service.

productPortfolio.name: F1 solar pool skimmer
productPortfolio.positioning: A solar-powered surface-cleaning robot that complements floor and wall cleaning.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Enables full-pool bundles but introduces a separate surface-care product and parts platform.

productPortfolio.name: Winny and ODM pool robots
productPortfolio.positioning: WYBOTICS also sells its Winny brand and produces commissioned products for outside pool-equipment customers.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Factory overlap does not prove product equivalence, shared certification, interchangeable parts or common warranty.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: WYBOTICS' April 2026 application proof says it manufactures substantially all products at owned facilities in Tianjin; the production base had three workshops and more than 10,000 square metres of gross floor area at the end of 2025.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm that the exact contracted model and batch are produced at the disclosed Tianjin facility.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The filing says WYBOTICS develops and manufactures substantially all key components used in branded and ODM products in-house and assembles products at its self-owned base.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Treat substantially all as a group statement; verify the bill of materials, origin and subcontracting for the exact SKU.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: A 2026 U.S. recall named WYBOTICS Co. Ltd. in Tianjin as manufacturer and Wybotics Inc. in California as importer for specified Osprey 700 Max and S1 units.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Named U.S. recall models and serial ranges
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Screen the exact model and serial number and do not generalize the importer or recall to every WYBOT product.

marketsChannels.evidence: WYBOTICS combines own-brand ecommerce, Amazon, third-party merchants, wholesale and distributors across regional markets.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm seller authorization, invoice identity and warranty eligibility for the target channel.

marketsChannels.evidence: Disclosed subsidiaries include Wybotics Inc. in the United States, WYBOTICS EUROPE in France and WYBOTICS HONGKONG COMPANY LIMITED, with different commercial or after-sales functions.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify which entity is seller, importer, exporter, warranty provider and data operator for the order.

marketsChannels.evidence: The U.S. warranty policy says coverage varies by model and generally ranges from 12 to 24 months, subject to territory, proof of purchase and authorized-channel conditions.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Obtain the written warranty matrix for the exact SKU, country and commercial channel.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: WYBOTICS combines its own Tianjin manufacturing base with own-brand and ODM production, giving WYBOT a wider cost and product-development foundation than a marketing-only brand. Its range extends from value cordless cleaners to vision, solar-dock and surface-skimming systems. The strategic challenge is to translate manufacturing scale into consistent software, safety, spare parts and after-sales performance across regional sellers while keeping own-brand and commissioned products clearly separated.

developments.title: WYBOTICS files a Hong Kong application proof
developments.summary: The draft filing documented the company's controlling-shareholder group, Tianjin production base, own brands, ODM business and regional subsidiaries; it did not confirm a completed listing.

developments.title: Specified WYBOT units enter a U.S. recall
developments.summary: The CPSC recalled named Osprey 700 Max and S1 models and separated the Tianjin manufacturer from the California importer.

developments.title: Wangyuan converts into WYBOTICS
developments.summary: The predecessor company converted into a joint stock limited company and adopted WYBOTICS Co.,LTD as its English corporate name.
